ratings.comment: I took 2 of professor Donnelley's classes over 20 years ago and I still think of how much I enjoyed the classes.  He was very passionate about his area of study and is a great lecturer.
I graduated 10 years ago, but still fondly remember Donnelly's lectures.
I took irish history and brit hist 1688 to the present. he was a great man, i hope he isnt retired. clearest lecturer, I learned so much from him. I admire Donnelly.
Donnelly was the sweetest most adorable professor ever! He was really funny and knew his stuff!

Donnelly is one of the best at UW. This man is a genius when it comes to British/Irish History & gives lectures w/ a great fire & passion. He had a great sense of humor and always opened class w/ an update on Badger Sports and the Yankees. Saying goodbye to Donnelly was also sad for me, since he is retiring after 40 wondrous years of teaching.
He was the best professor ever!!  Loved attending lecture and his TA's were awesome.  Saddest day of the semester shaking his hand to turn in my final, he's now retired :-(
One of the best!! Gives you exams at least a week ahead of time, likes to talk about current events and the Yankees before class. Lots of info in lecture so dont miss them.
Fantastic Professor!  One of the best.

One of the best profs i've ever had, extremely knowledgeable, kind and funny. teaches the material in an interesting way, dont miss lecture! the readings are generally very interesting and not hard to get through. Best class ever!

Tests: 2 ID's chosen from a list of 6.  1 essay to write chosen from 2-3 (usually 3).  A list of 7 possible essay topics sent out ~10 days prior.  The class will opt for 2 midterms, which allows you to weight them and the final to your liking (within set ranges).  Friendly, approachable, and interesting. DON'T MISS LECTURES!!!! (too much info)

Interesting class, gives a TON of information.  May be useful to learn how to write with both hands... Does give the option of taking multiple midterms and weighting them individually.  Sends out essay questions a few days before the test.  Funny guy with thick bronx accent.
Love him! His lectures are phenomonal.

Kicks ass, tells you exactly what he wants you to know, its importance, andlater if it will be on the test.  The guy actually tells gives you the essay questions two days before the tests.  You would have to be brain dead not to do well.  Very good lecturer, not a windbag.
A Very Efficient and clear professor, who clearly knows his material. I would recommend him highly. As for the accent, I don't really recognize it.... ?

Thick Bronx accent, likes to tell jokes and talk about the Yankees.  Knows his stuff, very friendly man if you get a chance to talk to him.  Gives essay ?'s before the test.  Gave our class the option of taking a second midterm and then being allowed to weight our tests as we saw fit.  Good prof.

Lectures are interesting, but are a continuous stream of information, so be prepared to write quickly. He is an extremely nice and helpful man, however, and gives out the test essays before the exam. Overall, a great class!

Very entertaining and makes lectures fun with his hilarious jokes before class. His tests are awesome because he gives you the essay questions on the test in the review study guide before the test...how cool is that?
amazing and interesting to listen too. my dad had him 30 years ago and loved him then too. be ready to work hard, but you will receive a good grade for your work. really nice guy too.
Fantastic history prof!  One of the best!
Great Prof! Like the yankees! :) He's funny, smart, and really knows his stuff.  The tests are fair and if you go to lecture you will be able to follow along.
No Comments
His accent will crack you up. Overall a great professor.
